Kada su tatovaže na tijelu gotove, svi se okupljaju, uključujući Crosby i Beara, kako bi dali mišljenje o tetovažama.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show
programme.desc: How do young people who've embraced the digital age find love? Often by connecting online with others they've never met in person before. These days, typing on iPhones has replaced the dinner date, while emailing through Facebook often substitutes for face-to-face conversations. The problem - that cute guy you may be falling in love with could be lying about who he really is. Now, from the producers of the hit feature documentary, Catfish, comes a new MTV series that brings together couples who've interacted solely through LCD screens. Over the course of months they've supposedly fallen in love - but what will happen when they meet in real life for the first time? With the guidance and help of Nev Schulman, the star of the original Catfish, in each episode, a hopeful romantic partner will go on an emotional trip to discover the truth about their significant other.

programme.title: Help! I'm in a Secret Relationship!
programme.desc: Seattle based Administrative Assistant, Kylee, wonders why her girlfriend Tonee is keeping their lives completely separate. When they met at a party two years ago, their chemistry was off the charts. Tonee only lives and works about forty minutes away from her in Tacoma, but it feels like a world apart. Tonee won't allow Kylee to see her burlesque performances or visit her home, and Kylee fears there is something or someone else. This is Kylee's first relationship with another woman, and she's frustrated to be giving so much of herself to someone who is barely giving her crumbs. After two years, Kylee cannot continue to live like this and wants answers.

programme.title: Help! I'm in a Secret Relationship!
programme.desc: It was love at first swipe for Bryan when he came across Elene's dating profile about a year ago. He was upset to find out that Elene was living in Georgia, the country, but she assured him that she would be moving to New York shortly. The two chatted every day prior to the move and Bryan felt he'd found someone special. A few months later when Elene finally moved, he knew he had no time to waste so he jumped at the opportunity to take her out before anyone else could. Bryan spent the next few months showing Elene around and introducing her to everyone he knew to help her settle into her new city. The relationship was perfect in Bryan's eyes but now that the novelty is wearing off, he's starting to notice some red flags that he overlooked. Elene won't introduce him to her family, even though she lives with her mom, and she won't post him on social media. Bryan wants to ask Elene to move in with him so they can start building a life together, but first he needs to find out why he's being hidden.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show
programme.desc: How do young people who've embraced the digital age find love? Often by connecting online with others they've never met in person before. These days, typing on iPhones has replaced the dinner date, while emailing through Facebook often substitutes for face-to-face conversations. The problem - that cute guy you may be falling in love with could be lying about who he really is. Now, from the producers of the hit feature documentary, Catfish, comes a new MTV series that brings together couples who've interacted solely through LCD screens. Over the course of months they've supposedly fallen in love - but what will happen when they meet in real life for the first time?

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show
programme.desc: How do young people who've embraced the digital age find love? Often by connecting online with others they've never met in person before. These days, typing on iPhones has replaced the dinner date, while emailing through Facebook often substitutes for face-to-face conversations. The problem - that cute guy you may be falling in love with could be lying about who he really is. Now, from the producers of the hit feature documentary, Catfish, comes a new MTV series that brings together couples who've interacted solely through LCD screens. Over the course of months they've supposedly fallen in love - but what will happen when they meet in real life for the first time? With the guidance and help of Nev Schulman, the star of the original Catfish, in each episode, a hopeful romantic partner will go on an emotional trip to discover the truth about their significant other.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show
programme.desc: Catfish: The TV Show brings together couples who've interacted solely through LCD screens. Over the course of months they've supposedly fallen in love - but what will happen when they meet in real life for the first time?

programme.title: Love & Hip Hop: Atlanta
programme.desc: Mixing the elevation of beloved OG's, with new chart topping artists, this group is intertwined in each other's money moves and inevitable mess! In an ATL era of rebounds, healing, retribution, can the ATL group reunite?

programme.title: Caught in the Act: Unfaithful
programme.desc: Bleu thought she knew exactly who she was building a future with-her video vixen partner, Lily. But when Lily's late nights and secretive behavior start raising serious questions, Bleu turns to Tami for answers. As the red flags stack up, Bleu uncovers a web of lies that hits closer than she ever expected.

programme.title: Ghosted: Love Gone Missing
programme.desc: Mariah was caught up in a tumultuous relationship with her ex, but coworker James slid in and the two slowly became secret lovebirds. That is until James didn't show up for his shift, quit his job and left Mariah with questions and broken promises.

programme.title: Caught in the Act: Unfaithful
programme.desc: Jalyssa has tried everything to catch Darren cheating, from fake social accounts to fake vacations. With no answers and trust running thin, Jalyssa turns to Tami for proof, but a shocking third party reveals that Darren might not be the only one with something to hide.

programme.title: Herbie Hancock Meets Bobby McFerrin and Michael Brecker
programme.desc: In this 1988 performance, The Herbie Hancock Trio plays together with famed vocalist Bobby McFerrin and saxophonist Michael Brecker. Jazz pianist and composer Herbie Hancock is perhaps one of the most famous contributors to the post-bop (a small combo jazz style) sound of the 1960s and '70s. He began his career with the Miles Davis Quintet where he helped to revolutionize the jazz rhythm section and later became known for his early adoption of the synthesizer, which led to his signature Jazz Rock Fusion style. In this live 1988 concert, held at the Munich Philharmonie, The Herbie Hancock Trio, with Hancock on piano, Buster Williams on bass, and Al Foster on drums, welcome vocalist Bobby McFerrin and saxophonist Michael Brecker for a mostly improvised concert. Together they play some of Hancock's most famous compositions, and in the second half, Hancock improvises on an IBM computer-enhanced Bösendorf Concert Grand. Set List: Air Dancing Oleo Improvisation 2 Hands Improvisation 4 Hands Cantaloupe Island 2 Hands Cantaloupe Island 4 Hands.

programme.title: The Herbie Hancock Trio
programme.desc: Watch Herbie Hancock and his Trio perform at the 1987 Munich Summer Piano Festival. Today, Herbie Hancock is fostering the next generation of great jazz musicians as the chairman of UCLA's Herbie Hancock Institute of Jazz. In 1987, he was influencing jazz in a different way. In that year, he won the Oscar for Best Musical Score and set off on a string of European concerts with his world-famous trio. This 1987 concert from Munich's Summer Piano Festival is the epitome of cool. Herbie Hancock opens with a casual and hypnotic piano solo and is then joined by Buster Williams on bass, and Al Foster on drums. Together they play songs from Herbie's 1966 album Maiden Voyage, one of Buster Williams' original compositions, and round things off with a classic Cole Porter tune. Set List: Dolphin Dance Air Dancing Just One of Those Things.

programme.title: Rumpelstiltskin
programme.desc: Newcastle-based balletLORENT filmed Rumpelstiltskin at Northern Stage, Newcastle, in October 2017, before touring the UK to much acclaim and success. Liv Lorent, Director and Choreographer balletLORENT, said: "Rumpelstiltskin is the story of the outsider, shunned for being different, and the secret power and knowledge he possesses. He is the original super mutant, a fairytale X-Man in a story of love, obsession, childhood, grief and reconciliation that is made as much for children as it is for adults.

programme.title: Tempest
programme.desc: "Tempest," starring Agnes Su of Stuttgart Ballet, is a mesmerizing dance film that captures the delicate tension between aspiration and self-acceptance. With stark simplicity and emotional honesty, Su's performance embodies the beauty and struggle of striving for perfection, revealing the quiet moments where vulnerability and grace meet. Elegant, intimate, and very moving, "Tempest" is a celebration of the artistry in imperfection and the courage it takes to dance on your own terms.

programme.title: Margot
programme.desc: This is the story of how the most famous dancer that England ever produced was deceived and betrayed by those closest to her; of hos a little girl called Peggy Hookham, brought up in Shanghai, told her mother she would one day become the greatest dancer in the world; and of how, in spite of being almost unable to walk, she was still performing when she was 67.

programme.title: Maestras: A Long Journey of Women to the Podium
programme.desc: When a woman steps onto the conductor's podium, she is always one of "the first": the first to lead a world-class orchestra, the first to conduct the closing night of London's "Proms," the first to win the German Conductor Prize. It seems as though the world of orchestral conducting might finally be ready to change it's attitudes toward female conductors for good.

programme.title: Instinct
programme.desc: Three fighters, one vital resource, no room for compromise. "Instinct" is a tense, physically charged short dance film built around a single life-or-death struggle. As the dancers clash over water, their movement becomes a test of endurance, urgency, and survival. Their movements are sharp, stripped-back, and unflinching. Bodies strain, collide, and resist, mirroring the brutal realities of scarcity and entitlement. Every action carries consequences, and every choice exposes what desperation can bring in each of us. With a stark visual language and urgent momentum, this is a gripping meditation on survival, power, and the cost of getting what we need.

programme.title: Viva Verdi
programme.desc: Celebrating Verdi's bi-centenary, the spectacular National Centre for the Performing Arts in Beijing hosted a unique Gala Concert, produced by Accentus Music: An international cast of renowned European and Chinese singers and the NCPA orchestra under the baton of its principal conductor Lu Jia presented a wide selection of Verdi opera classics. "Viva Verdi" was directed and staged by the multi talented Verdi specialist Hugo de Ana, acclaimed for exquisite scenery sets as well as for his extraordinary lighting design.

programme.title: Una Notte a Napoli
programme.desc: Set to music by Pink Martini, "Una Notte a Napoli" ( A Night in Napoli) is a playful and cinematic dance film that is delightfully whimsical, romantic, and just a little bit strange. Directed and choreographed by Lucia Lopez Sanchez, the film flows with a teasing charm, leading us through a story that hints of mystery, mischief, and fleeting joys without ever fully revealing its secrets. Every gesture and sequence is an unmissable balance of humor and drama. A cinematic delight, "Una Notte a Napoli" celebrates the joy, impermanence, and playful strangeness of everyday life.

programme.title: Tempest
programme.desc: "Tempest," starring Agnes Su of Stuttgart Ballet, is a mesmerizing dance film that captures the delicate tension between aspiration and self-acceptance. With stark simplicity and emotional honesty, Su's performance embodies the beauty and struggle of striving for perfection, revealing the quiet moments where vulnerability and grace meet. Elegant, intimate, and very moving, "Tempest" is a celebration of the artistry in imperfection and the courage it takes to dance on your own terms.

programme.title: Daniel Barenboim - Beethoven: Complete Piano Sonatas: No. 4, Op. 7
programme.desc: GRAMMY Award-winning pianist and conductor Daniel Barenboim tackles the so-called "New Testament" of music, Ludwig van Beethoven's thirty-two piano sonatas. Composed over twenty-five years and embodying the shift of musical taste from the Classic to the Romantic, their performance requires a musician of extraordinary versatility. Daniel Barenboim is one such pianist - his recordings run the gamut from Bach and Mozart to Bruckner and Bartók. In following in the footsteps of such masters as Artur Schnabel, Barenboim truly shows himself to be among the greatest living musicians.

programme.title: Back to the Beginning with Barbara Hannigan
programme.desc: Go behind the curtain and into the hearts of the world's most iconic performers. In Back to the Beginning, we explore the untold stories of how legendary artists began their incredible careers, from their first steps on stage to becoming masters of their craft. In this episode, go back to the beginning with accomplished Soprano and Conductor Barbara Hannigan. Between rehearsals with the London Symphony Orchestra, we sat down with Barbara Hannigan to find out how she got her start, what drives her passion for music, and the moments in her career that left a lasting impression. From her roots in rural Nova Scotia to her first premiere at just 19 years old, find out what drives her creativity and her endless motivation for music making.

programme.title: Much Ado About Nothing
programme.desc: The story follows Beatrice and Benedick, two quick-witted and sarcastic individuals who are happily single, but whose friends believe they would make a great romantic match. Set in the Early Modern world, an era of ever-changing attitudes towards marriage and power, the play presents a society at once filled with progressive feminist impulses and countervailing forces rooted in traditional patriarchal values. With his astonishing wit and insight, Shakespeare explores the complexities that underlie these growing social tensions.

programme.title: Macbeth
programme.desc: Sir Patrick Stewart stars in a gripping cinematic adaptation of Shakespeare's blood-soaked tragedy, transplanted into a contemporary world. Director Rupert Goold relocates the Scottish play to the oppressive atmosphere of Nicolae Ceauşescu's Romania, drawing parallels between the ruthless dictator and Macbeth's insatiable lust for power. The iconic Three Witches are reimagined as hospital nurses, their spectral presence underscoring the horror of Macbeth's murderous reign. Shot on location in the eerie underground labyrinth of Welbeck Abbey, Nottinghamshire, this film is based on the Tony Award-winning stage production starring Sir Patrick Stewart that captivated Broadway audiences and critics. Kate Fleetwood reprises her chilling portrayal of the manipulative Lady Macbeth.

programme.title: Rumpelstiltskin
programme.desc: Newcastle-based balletLORENT filmed Rumpelstiltskin at Northern Stage, Newcastle, in October 2017, before touring the UK to much acclaim and success. Liv Lorent, Director and Choreographer balletLORENT, said: "Rumpelstiltskin is the story of the outsider, shunned for being different, and the secret power and knowledge he possesses. He is the original super mutant, a fairytale X-Man in a story of love, obsession, childhood, grief and reconciliation that is made as much for children as it is for adults.

programme.title: Sir András Schiff Performs Mendelssohn Piano Concerto No. 2
programme.desc: Experience Mendelssohn's masterpiece as it was meant to be heard. Sir András Schiff and the Orchestra of the Age of Enlightenment unite historical authenticity with extraordinary artistry at London's Queen Elizabeth Hall. Schiff performs on a rare 1859 Blüthner fortepiano, revealing the fiery brilliance and lyrical beauty of "Piano Concerto No. 2 in D Minor, Op. 40", all while seamlessly conducting from the keyboard. This concerto's unconventional three-movement structure was revolutionary for its time, setting a bold new standard for expressive piano composition. Renowned for their meticulous research and artistry, the OAE and Schiff bring Mendelssohn's genius to life, blending the Romantic era's passion with the precision of period instruments. Filmed live in April 2024 as part of the OAE's ''Mendelssohn: The Complete Symphonies series.'.

programme.title: Daniel Barenboim - Beethoven Complete Piano Sonatas: No.24, Op.78 For Therese
programme.desc: Pianist and conductor Daniel Barenboim tackles the so-called "New Testament" of music, Ludwig van Beethoven's thirty-two piano sonatas.

programme.title: Sir Simon Rattle - Berliner Philharmoniker - Mozart / Haydn
programme.desc: At this summer's LUCERNE FESTIVAL, Sir Simon Rattle and the Berliner Philharmoniker presented a new Haydn symphony that never existed before: Rattle gathered together ten of the most original and avant-garde-like instrumental movements by Joseph Haydn to fashion a Symphonie imaginaire. In addition to this astonishing Haydn Pasticcio, Rattle conducted Mozart's Sinfonia concertante for violin, viola and orchestra, soloists were Daishin Kashimoto (violin) and Amihai Grosz (viola).

programme.title: Sir Simon Rattle - Berliner Philharmoniker - Mozart: The Last Symphonies
programme.desc: Simon Rattle and the Berliner Philharmoniker take on a myth with their complete performance of the last three symphonies by Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart. To this day we still don't know for what occasion they were written, when they were first performed, or even whether the composer himself ever heard them. For the Romantics, these three scores represented Mozart' legacy to posterity - but for Rattle they signify an interpretive challenge of the first order: "Here human emotions are pushed to the absolute extreme," he explains. "You have the feeling that you're conducting three very concentrated operas in the same evening." Mozart's music is for him in any case incomparable: "It is deeply emotional and passionate and dark and dangerous and cheerful like no other music that has ever been written. If you approach it with caution, you really have a problem. Everything in this music is so natural that you have to forget the rules.

programme.title: Don Giovanni Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart
programme.desc: Seducer, suborner, unscrupulous, savage, deaf to the lamentations of abandoned women, to the threats of their outraged fathers as to those of heaven, Don Juan the libertine listens only to his pleasures. But destiny is watching, and the vengeance of his victims awaits its time... What does the myth of Don Juan still have to say to us today? For Flemish director Guy Cassiers, the whirlwind of unrelenting love, the dizzying seductions, the swooning ingenues and the lively marivaudages are all fuelled by a hint of violence - physical, symbolic, political and social... But let the party begin! After brilliantly reviving Lully's Xerse and Purcell's Indian Queen in Lille, Guy Cassiers now turns his attention to the immortal seducer, tracking down the conflicts hidden behind his mask of sensual freedom. He has chosen to make her the face of a world in decline, halfway between the crudeness of a slaughterhouse and the splendour of a dazzling palace... Mirror contrasts, as Mozart and Da Ponte's masterpiece combines the most extreme feelings with the most graceful musical refinement... Already a partner of Guy Cassiers in 2015 and 2019, Emmanuelle Haïm returns here to a work in which her passion for Mozart and the singularity of the Concert d'Astrée's timbres work wonders. After the incandescent memories left in Lille by her Marriage of Figaro and a memorable Così fan tutte, here, for the centenary of the Opéra, is this summit of opera.

programme.title: Haydn's Creation from Ljubljana Festival
programme.desc: A cosmic drama of light, life, and music, Haydn's "The Creation" is reborn in this dazzling new staging. Joseph Haydn's monumental oratorio "The Creation" is one of the great masterpieces of the Classical Era. Written in 1798 and inspired by Handel's great oratorios, "The Creation" tells the biblical story of the world's creation with breathtaking drama, poetry, and spiritual depth. From the primordial chaos before creation to the jubilant dawn of life, Haydn's score remains as powerful and moving today as it was at its premiere in 1799. At the 73rd Ljubljana Festival in Slovenia, Haydn's monumental work takes on a captivating new life in a visionary staging by La Fura dels Baus, the ground-breaking Catalan theatre collective celebrated for their bold fusion of classical music with incredible stage design. This production transforms Haydn's score into an immersive experience where music, theater, and visual storytelling come together to create an unforgettable experience. The incredible ADDA Simfònica Alicante and the Slovenian Philharmonic Choir, led by Josep Vincent, give an outstanding performance. Soloists Alba Fernández-Cano, Víctor Sordo, and Toni Marsol bring the archangels and first humans to life, infusing Haydn's beloved music with dramatic power. This is "The Creation" as you've never seen it before.

programme.title: Inside the Rose International Dance Prize
programme.desc: Four visionary choreographers, one groundbreaking prize. The Rose International Dance Prize takes center stage in this powerful documentary that follows the inaugural season of the prestigious new award celebrating the boldest voices in choreography in the world. Created and hosted by London's iconic Sadler's Wells Theatre, this exciting new award aims to shine a spotlight on the best global choreographic talent. This ground-breaking documentary, narrated by award-winning actress and director Fiona Shaw, follows four trailblazing choreographers from Portugal, Brazil, Greece, and the USA, as they compete for the first ever Rose Prize. From rehearsal studios to electrifying performances and the dramatic reveal of the 2025 winner, this film offers a rare look at the creative process and people behind some of the most powerful contemporary dance works on the planet. Whether exploring identity, climate, resilience, or tradition, each finalist's piece pushes choreography in thrilling new directions. Featuring commentary from the finalists, Kyle Abraham ("An Untitled Love"), Marco da Silva Ferreira ("Carcaça"), Christos Papadopoulos ("Larsen C"), and Lia Rodrigues ("Encantado"), the esteemed panel of judges, PJ Harvey, Dame Arlene Phillips and Karthika Naïr, and post-show reactions from the audience, this is your front-row seat to choreographic history in the making.

programme.title: Sir Simon Rattle - Berliner Philharmoniker - Mozart / Haydn
programme.desc: At this summer's LUCERNE FESTIVAL, Sir Simon Rattle and the Berliner Philharmoniker presented a new Haydn symphony that never existed before: Rattle gathered together ten of the most original and avant-garde-like instrumental movements by Joseph Haydn to fashion a Symphonie imaginaire. programme.title: You and Me
programme.desc: Zhang Yimou, the renowned Chinese film director and winner of the Golden Globe Award (Red Cornfield, Red Lantern, Hero, House of Flying Daggers), is staging his first Peking opera at the NCPA, spectacularly fusing the traditional and modern together for his production of You and Me. The result is an overwhelming feast for the senses. Lavish and colorful costumes, unique music composed and conducted by Zhu Shaoyu, and a world class ensemble that features the greatest stars of the Peking opera, including Meng Guanglu, Shi Yihong and Li Mingyan, turn You and Me into an unforgettable experience. You and Me is based on the age-old tale from the Zuo legend "Lord Zheng defeats Duan in Yan" - a story about deceit and the power of filial love. Zhang Yimou recounts the story using the stylistic elements of the Peking opera, which in turn he makes accessible for an entirely new audience.

programme.title: Death and the King's Horseman
programme.desc: The Greater The Honour, The Deeper The Shame In British-occupied Nigeria, a Yoruba king, the Alafin, has died, and it is the duty of his horseman, Elesin, to accompany him into the afterlife. While lustily enjoying the pleasures of this world, Elesin proudly anticipates his transition to the next - but the sacred ritual is interrupted, resulting in unforeseen tragedy. Inspired by a real-life incident, this masterpiece from Nobel Prize winner Soyinka celebrates a community striving to uphold its culture in the face of colonial power.

programme.title: The Land of Smiles
programme.desc: "Always smile and always be cheerful, always satisfied, no matter what happens, smile in spite of your sorrows and a thousand aches and pains," sings Prince Sou-Chong, thus introducing the fundamentally melancholy tone of this operetta, which even has a tragic ending in store. Franz Lehár's operetta Das Land des Lächelns ("The Land of Smiles") is one of the best-known hits of all time - and, according to Kurt Tucholsky, is the "the Puccini for the common man." Like Puccini's Madame Butterfly, Lehar focuses on Asian subjects, thematizing the European attraction for the exotic in the encounter of two people whose love is shattered by foreign customs and ancient traditions. For the production of this operetta Piotr Beczala, a world star who cultivates the tradition of the famous Tauber style like no other, was returning to the Opernhaus Zürich as Sou-Chong. He has an equal partner in Julia Kleiter, who plays the role of Lisa. Fabio Luisi and Andreas Homoki also know that the genre of operetta requires particular care - which is why they have assumed personal responsibility for this production.

programme.title: Viva Verdi
programme.desc: Celebrating Verdi's bi-centenary, the spectacular National Centre for the Performing Arts in Beijing hosted a unique Gala Concert, produced by Accentus Music: An international cast of renowned European and Chinese singers and the NCPA orchestra under the baton of its principal conductor Lu Jia presented a wide selection of Verdi opera classics. "Viva Verdi" was directed and staged by the multi talented Verdi specialist Hugo de Ana, acclaimed for exquisite scenery sets as well as for his extraordinary lighting design.

programme.title: Käfig: Mosaïk
programme.desc: Enter a world where hip-hop meets contemporary dance and boldly redefines the possibilities of movement. Conceived in Togo by renowned choreographer Mourad Merzouki, this groundbreaking production assembles five virtuosic dancers to reinterpret iconic moments from Compagnie Käfig's celebrated repertoire, which spans three decades and over 4,000 performances. Blurring artistic boundaries, Merzouki blends the raw energy of street dance with the precision of ballet, the spectacle of circus, and the grace of classical music. The result transcends traditional dance, inviting audiences into an entirely new artistic realm.

programme.title: Songs of the Wanderers
programme.desc: Cloud Gate Dance Theatre's visually stunning work is a meditative journey that seamlessly blends dance, nature, and ancient wisdom. Choreographed by the esteemed Lin Hwai-min, dancers evoke spiritual pilgrimages inspired by Herman Hesse's account of Siddhartha's quest and the introspective religious practices found throughout Asia. A lone monk stands in complete stillness as three tons of golden rice grains flow onto his head and to the stage, creating a shifting landscape of hills, deserts, and rivers that usher the dancers along their journey. Enchanting Georgian folksongs reverberate through the space while dancers sift through the sandy rice creating a powerful narrative of self-discovery and the pursuit of enlightenment.

programme.title: Daniel Barenboim - Beethoven: Complete Piano Sonatas: No. 26, Op. 81a Les adieux
programme.desc: GRAMMY Award-winning pianist and conductor Daniel Barenboim tackles the so-called "New Testament" of music, Ludwig van Beethoven's thirty-two piano sonatas. programme.title: Romeo and Juliet
programme.desc: Falling headlong in love, two teenagers defy the long-simmering hatred between their families - but daring to love one's enemy comes with a terrible cost. The famous tragedy of star-crossed lovers has never been more heartbreaking than in this captivating production by the Stratford Festival.

programme.title: Matthew Bourne's Romeo & Juliet
programme.desc: Passion and heartbreak collide in this contemporary retelling of Shakespeare's timeless tale, exploring the madness of forbidden first love. Locked away in an asylum by a society intent on crushing their youthful spirits, our star-crossed lovers must risk everything to be together. Bourne's trademark storytelling bursts with raw energy, bringing both suppressed and explosive passions to the surface. Romeo and Juliet's first kiss remains unbroken as they roll across the floor and climb stairs, defying the world around them. Cordelia Braithwaite's Juliet is a tragic figure whose strength and courage have been warped by the life forced upon her. The goofy, charming Romeo, played by Paris Fitzpatrick, serves as her perfect foil. The film's shocking climax springs from Juliet's deep trauma. In this radical reinterpretation of Shakespeare's classic, love and sex are portrayed as dangerous forces in a world that demands conformity.

programme.title: The Sonnets By William Shakespeare
programme.desc: If only Shakespeare himself could have streamed this episode, which explores the tragedy of absence and yearning. This episode features sonnets 52 to 103. These sonnets rank among his most enthralling works, revealing deep insecurities with unflinching candor. The Bard's poetry comes alive through a stellar cast, including Dame Harriet Walter, Simon Callow, and Stephen Fry, while rare glimpses of the original 1609 quarto transport viewers across four centuries of literary history. Immerse yourself in these masterpieces, where extended metaphors flourish, emotions take shape, and the rhythm of iambic pentameter unveils eternal truths about love, jealousy, and the human condition.

programme.title: The Understudy
programme.desc: Multi award-winning short film, The Understudy is a peek-behind-the-curtain story of the theatre world. An understudy actor (Tom Rooney) is called upon last-minute to replace the star of a major stage production of Shakespeare's The Tempest. He is also looking after his young granddaughter, and has no choice but to bring her to the theatre. This could be a late-life career break but he only has a few hours to get ready, the stage manager is stressed, and his granddaughter has gone missing backstage.

programme.title: Margot

As the dancers clash over water, their movement becomes a test of endurance, urgency, and survival. Their movements are sharp, stripped-back, and unflinching. Bodies strain, collide, and resist, mirroring the brutal realities of scarcity and entitlement. Every action carries consequences, and every choice exposes what desperation can bring in each of us. With a stark visual language and urgent momentum, this is a gripping meditation on survival, power, and the cost of getting what we need.

programme.title: Daniel Barenboim - Beethoven: Complete Piano Sonatas: No. 13, Op. 27.1
programme.desc: GRAMMY Award-winning pianist and conductor Daniel Barenboim tackles the so-called "New Testament" of music, Ludwig van Beethoven's thirty-two piano sonatas. Composed over twenty-five years and embodying the shift of musical taste from the Classic to the Romantic, their performance requires a musician of extraordinary versatility. Daniel Barenboim is one such pianist - his recordings run the gamut from Bach and Mozart to Bruckner and Bartók. In following in the footsteps of such masters as Artur Schnabel, Barenboim truly shows himself to be among the greatest living musicians.

programme.title: J. S. Bach: The Six Brandenburg Concertos
programme.desc: Johann Sebastian Bach's Brandenburg Concertos rank among the most popular works of Baroque music. To mark their 300th anniversary in 2021, Collegium 1704 played all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in Köthen Castle's restored Hall of Mirrors. Founded by Václav Luks in 2005, the orchestra is one of the most renowned ensembles of our time specializing in baroque music. Given the great stylistic and structural diversity of these concertos, they were the perfect choice to record these musical gems at the historical location of their inception.

programme.title: Montreux Jazz Festival
programme.desc: Solange Knowles is a visionary artist whose distinctive voice, genre-defying sound, and fearless creativity have earned her a place among music's most influential figures. Though she first emerged in the shadow of her sister Beyoncé, Solange quickly forged her own path, challenging expectations and redefining success on her own terms. Determined to retain artistic control in the regimented corporate music landscape, Solonge has consistently pushed creative boundaries through her music, visual art, and performance. With four critically acclaimed studio albums, she has established herself as a creative force who isn't afraid to confront social issues or experiment with form. In this episode of Memory Lane, get a fascinating picture of how Solonge rose to fame and experience her transcendent 2017 performance at the Montreux Jazz Festival. Set List: Cranes in The Sky Rise Weary Some Things Never Seem to F*cking Work T.O.N.Y Losing You Don't You Wait Junie Mad Don't Touch My Hair.

programme.title: Una Notte a Napoli
programme.desc: Set to music by Pink Martini, "Una Notte a Napoli" ( A Night in Napoli) is a playful and cinematic dance film that is delightfully whimsical, romantic, and just a little bit strange. Directed and choreographed by Lucia Lopez Sanchez, the film flows with a teasing charm, leading us through a story that hints of mystery, mischief, and fleeting joys without ever fully revealing its secrets. Every gesture and sequence is an unmissable balance of humor and drama. A cinematic delight, "Una Notte a Napoli" celebrates the joy, impermanence, and playful strangeness of everyday life.

programme.title: Much Ado About Nothing
programme.desc: The story follows Beatrice and Benedick, two quick-witted and sarcastic individuals who are happily single, but whose friends believe they would make a great romantic match. Set in the Early Modern world, an era of ever-changing attitudes towards marriage and power, the play presents a society at once filled with progressive feminist impulses and countervailing forces rooted in traditional patriarchal values. With his astonishing wit and insight, Shakespeare explores the complexities that underlie these growing social tensions.

programme.title: The Sonnets By William Shakespeare
programme.desc: If only Shakespeare himself could have streamed this episode, which explores the tragedy of absence and yearning. This episode features sonnets 52 to 103. These sonnets rank among his most enthralling works, revealing deep insecurities with unflinching candor. The Bard's poetry comes alive through a stellar cast, including Dame Harriet Walter, Simon Callow, and Stephen Fry, while rare glimpses of the original 1609 quarto transport viewers across four centuries of literary history. Immerse yourself in these masterpieces, where extended metaphors flourish, emotions take shape, and the rhythm of iambic pentameter unveils eternal truths about love, jealousy, and the human condition.

programme.title: Move to Live with Akram Khan
programme.desc: Francesca Hayward joined the Royal Ballet in London at the age of eighteen and since 2016 she has been a Principal dancer. She talks to Akram about her grandmother buying her a ballet video when she was three, how the stories she saw enveloped her, and how the drama of dance became her all-consuming passion. She says ''as a small person'' she likes to surprise people by using the stage to the max - her big jumps ''eating up the space'' and feeling like flying. And how although she doesn't enjoy swimming on the surface of water, underwater she feels at home, ''like a fish.'' Francesca opens up to Akram about how she gets her body and mind into gear as she prepares to be confident and calm for a performance.

programme.title: Simon Boccanegra
programme.desc: Intrigue, family tragedies, power struggles - these words aptly describe Giuseppe Verdi's opera "Simon Boccanegra". And the opera is somehow frighteningly topical: in this piece with only one female role, the men write history and the women are the victims. The world premiere flopped, but almost 25 years later the opera received thunderous applause at a new performance in Milan's La Scala. Andreas Homoki has staged this second and revised version at the Zurich Opera House. Its premiere was one of the last conducted by outgoing music director Fabio Luisi and Christian Gerhaher's much-lauded role debut as Simon Boccanegra.

programme.title: The Land of Smiles
programme.desc: "Always smile and always be cheerful, always satisfied, no matter what happens, smile in spite of your sorrows and a thousand aches and pains," sings Prince Sou-Chong, thus introducing the fundamentally melancholy tone of this operetta, which even has a tragic ending in store. Franz Lehár's operetta Das Land des Lächelns ("The Land of Smiles") is one of the best-known hits of all time - and, according to Kurt Tucholsky, is the "the Puccini for the common man." Like Puccini's Madame Butterfly, Lehar focuses on Asian subjects, thematizing the European attraction for the exotic in the encounter of two people whose love is shattered by foreign customs and ancient traditions. For the production of this operetta Piotr Beczala, a world star who cultivates the tradition of the famous Tauber style like no other, was returning to the Opernhaus Zürich as Sou-Chong. He has an equal partner in Julia Kleiter, who plays the role of Lisa. Fabio Luisi and Andreas Homoki also know that the genre of operetta requires particular care - which is why they have assumed personal responsibility for this production.

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: Dve sestre. Dve eksplozivne ličnosti. Pod jednim krovom. "Sestre" je komedija o svakodnevnom životu dve sestre, od kojih jedna ima 7, a druga 13 godina. Marin je i dalje dete, dok njena starija sestra Vendi ulazi u tinejdžerske godine. Obe su temperamentne, veoma različite ličnosti i obožavaju se! Marin je naivna, simpatična, veoma hiperaktivna i veoma napadna. Ona uvek smišlja lude ideje da bi privukla pažnju svoje sestre, dok Vendi više teži životu odrasle osobe. Ova komedija karaktera govori o bratstvu/sestrinstvu.

programme.desc: Džeronimo je gospodin miš koji, pored toga što voli svoj posao i svoju porodicu, obožava da skuplja korice starog sira iz osamnaestog veka. programme.desc: Prestižni dijamant izložen u Britanskom muzeju upravo je ukraden i krađa nosi potpis Vorogula, ozloglašenog patuljka kradljivca dijamanata. Problem je u tome što je pomenuti kradljivac još uvek zatvoren u veoma dobro obezbeđenom delu zatvora Grinsajd.

programme.title: Ulica zagonetki
programme.desc: Golijat, pas strah i trepet u parku, koga se boje sve lutalice, nalazi protivnika jačeg od sebe: stvorenje sa crnim krznom i sjajnim očima koje stoji na zadnjim nogama poput vukodlaka.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! i veverice
programme.desc: Veverice i njihove drugarice pokušavaju da smanje emisiju ugljenika kada ih Žanet prijavi na takmičenje za zaštitu okoline.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! i veverice
programme.desc: Alvin će se toliko zaljubiti u devojčicu iz škole da će pristati da joj pričuva pticu. Ali kad bude izgovorio nešto loše, zabrinuće se da ptica možda to ne ponovi pred Minom. Mora da nađe način da spreči pticu da ne blebeće.

programme.title: Pets klub
programme.desc: Kevinova lasica Bela je nestala, a kavez je i dalje zaključan... Dakle, neko ju je uzeo! Tokom ove istrage, Oskar oseća da ga Kevin ugrožava, jer se razmeće svojim znanjem o životinjama, čak se prijavljuje i da postane član kluba. Tim i Nina su veoma otvorene za to, ali kada vidi Oskarovo oklevanje, Kevin im nudi dogovor: pridružiće se klubu ako on uspe da nađe Belu... Mada Oskar otkriva da kavez iz kog je Bela navodno pobegla pripada drugoj životinji, jer bi ona jako lako mogla da pobegne kroz rešetke.

programme.title: Pets klub
programme.desc: Kamel je upravo dobila škotskog skaj terijera Ririja, ali začudo, Riri svakog dana nestaje na nekoliko sati, a zatim se sam vraća kući. Kuda to ide? Pets klub istražuje, prati psa, ali mu svaki put izgubi trag. Oskar zatim postavlja minijaturnu video-kameru na Ririja. Zahvaljujući snimku, na kraju shvataju da Riri odlazi do kuće svog bivšeg vlasnika. Veoma odani Riri ne može da podnese razdvojenost od svog bivšeg vlasnika.

programme.title: Mali Šef: Nazad na posao
programme.desc: Uz pomoć svog starijeg brata i partnera, Tima, Mali šef nastavlja da se bori u surovom korporativnom svetu firme Bebeći Odred, dok se svim silama trudi da postigne skoro neverovatnu stvar: balans između poslovnog i privatnog života.

programme.title: Mali Šef: Nazad na posao
programme.desc: Uz pomoć svog starijeg brata i partnera, Tima, Mali šef nastavlja da se bori u surovom korporativnom svetu firme Bebeći Odred, dok se svim silama trudi da postigne skoro neverovatnu stvar: balans između poslovnog i privatnog života.

programme.title: Ulica zagonetki
programme.desc: Mačka sa dugim kandžama, šarenog krzna i sa izvajanom maskom, upada u kraljičinu spavaću sobu usred noći i odnosi monarha kao da se služi čarolijom.

programme.title: Barbi i Tajna Vrata
programme.desc: U ovoj čarobnoj, muzičkoj avanturi, Barbi glumi Aleksu, stidljivu princezu koja bi radije čitala nego izvršavala svoje kraljevske dužnosti. Šetajući kroz kraljevski vrt, Aleksa otkriva tajna vrata u svoje kraljevstvo, koje po mnogo čemu podseća na ono iz knjige koju čita! Kročiće kroz vrata i stupiti u čudnovatu zemlju punu čarobnih stvorenja i iznenađenja. Aleksa sreće Romi i Nori, sirenu i vilu, koje joj objašnjavaju da pokvarena vladarka po imenu Malucija pokušava da preuzme svu čaroliju u zemlji. Na svoje iznenađenje, Aleksa ima čarobne moći u ovom svetu i njene nove prijateljice su sigurne da samo ona može povratiti čaroliju u njihovoj zemlji. Otkrijte šta se dešava kada Aleksa skupi hrabrost da odbrani ono što je ispravno i sazna da je moć prijateljstva mnogo dragocenija od čarolije.

programme.title: Barbi i Stejsi kreću u spasavanje
programme.desc: Dosegnite nove visine uz Barbi i njenu mlađu sestru, Stejsi, dok kreću u pustolovinu života! Samouverena i pustolovna Stejsi će završiti u nezgodnoj situaciji kada Robertsovi krenu u Viskonsin na festival letećih balona - premlada je za aktivnosti sa odraslima, a prestara za igru sa malom decom. Ali kada Barbi i Skiper upadnu u nevolju, Stejsi ima prave veštine da spasi stvar. Upoznajte Stejsi kao nikada pre, uz pet novih originalnih songova, nove drugare, i više kuca nego ikada.

programme.title: Barbi: Avanture u kući iz snova
programme.desc: Upoznaj Barbi i njene najbolje drugare - zajedno sa prvim komšijom Kenom - u ovom animiranom vlogu avantura snimljenom u njenoj porodičnoj kući snova.

programme.title: Lego prijatelji: Sledeće poglavlje
programme.desc: Alija, Otem, Lijen i Nova organizuju prespavanjac u Oteminoj štali. Leo i Zak su oduševljeni Novinim dronom, te će i oni doći na prespavanjac kako bi saznali više o njemu. Strašna priča, nestanak hrane, munje, gromovi, jezivi zvukovi i sablasne senke navode družinu da posumnjaju na duhove.

programme.title: Nekada Davno - Predmeti
programme.desc: Maestro i Psi odlaze u vožnju, kada im odjednom nestane goriva! Maestro odlazi da nađe benzinsku stanicu, ali završava u 1770. godini, vozeći preteču modernog automobila, mnogo sporiju od konja. Potom juri za Minusom i Krastijem, koji su pobegli sa svim bocama sa benzinom.

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: Marina želi da gleda strašni film sa zombijima koji nije za decu i odlučuje da se pretvara da mesečari. Ali Vendi ne pada na to i želi da provede veče gledajući film sama sa Maksansom, pa šalje Marinu u njenu sobi. Marina se pretvara da je zombi, a Maksans stvarno naseda na to.

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: Sestre misle da su ovog puta možda preterale sa svojim izmotavanjem. Odlučuju da se sakriju u šumi, samo nekoliko metara od kuće, i tako izbegnu kaznu. Ali roditelji to otkrivaju. Tata je siguran da one neće moći da se nose sa divljinom.

programme.title: Alvin i veverice
programme.desc: Veverice pomažu vlasniku da popravi svoj letnji kamp i svoj loš odnos s bratom.

programme.title: Alvin i veverice
programme.desc: Kad se jedan Sajmonov izum pokvari, Džanet i Alvin zamene mesta i sad moraju da žive život ovog drugog.

programme.title: Alvin i veverice
programme.desc: Alvin je ubeđen da ga je Teodor prokleo da više nikad ne laže i ne može da se kontroliše da ne izbrblja istinu.

programme.title: Pustolovine sa Braćom Kret
programme.desc: Tokom svog godišnjeg Dana pranja veša, braća se ne slažu u vezi sa tim šta je bolje: plavi okeani ili zelene šume. Neslaganje je veće nego obično. Aviva preuzima ulogu sudije da bi pokazala kako okeani i šume sarađuju, čineći planetu na kojoj živimo celovitom, baš kao što Martin i Kris moraju da nastave da sarađuju. Može li ekipa da pomiri Martina i Krisa na vreme da bi spasila planetu od zlih planova Zaka i Pejzli Kaldrme.

programme.title: Pustolovine sa Braćom Kret
programme.desc: Tokom svog godišnjeg Dana pranja veša, braća se ne slažu u vezi sa tim šta je bolje: plavi okeani ili zelene šume. Neslaganje je veće nego obično. Aviva preuzima ulogu sudije da bi pokazala kako okeani i šume sarađuju i čineći planetu na kojoj živimo celovitom, baš kao što Martin i Kris moraju da nastave da sarađuju. Može li ekipa ponovo da uskladi Martina i Krisa na vreme da bi spasila planetu od zlih planova Zaka i Pejzli Kaldrme.

programme.title: Nekada Davno - Predmeti
programme.desc: Maestra i Psi iznenađuje oluja. Nažalost, nemaju kišobran. Maestro vodi Psi u potragu za jednim. Otkrivaju da se prvi kišobran pojavio u Kini pre više od 3.000 godina. Nije prilagođen kiši i koristi se kao zaštita od sunca.

programme.title: Nekada Davno - Predmeti
programme.desc: Maestro šeta po parku kada nailazi na malu Psi, koja pokušava da nacrta junaka mange. Ali toliko je koristila gumicu, da je ostao samo komadić! Maestro nudi da joj nabavi novu gumicu i koristi priliku da je odvede u srednji vek gde otkrivaju da su monasi pisari ispravljali greške struganjem.

programme.title: Radoznali Džordž
programme.desc: Džordž i Majk utrčavaju kod Pizgetija da se sklone od oluje koja je uništila Džordžovog novog zmaja. Džordž je skrhan. Kiša sve uništava! Dok Njoki drema, Džordž se duri - dok mu profesori Pica i Ajnštajn ne objasne da bez kiše ne bi bilo vode, ni Pizgetijevih špageta! Profesori čak pokazuju Džordžu prezentaciju o tome kako kap kiše Kapljica na čudesan način putuje do čaše vode. Malo nepoverljiv i mnogo pospan, Džordž se sklupčava uz Njoki - i nalazi se u fantastičnom snu sa Kapljicom u olujnom oblaku! Dok Džordž i Kapljica padaju sa neba u reku, Kapetan Njoki doleće na svom brodu da spasi stvar. Ali to je samo početak šašavog putovanja od neba do slavine. Hoće li trojac uspeti bezbedno da stigne do Pizgetijeve sudopere? I hoće li Džordž konačno shvatiti da je kiša zapanjujuća.

programme.title: Radoznali Džordž
programme.desc: Džordž voli da pomaže profesorima Ajnštajnu i Pici da provere svoje nove izume, naročito u prašumi, gde Džordž može da nosi ""Njuškač"" da bi našao retku orhideju. Kada Njuškač oseti miris, podaci putuju do računara profesora da bi našla svoj par - a Majkov ""Prateći nos"" treba da im kaže šta to Džordž njuši. Ali prašuma je prava zavrzlama bogatih mirisa, i računar ne može da prati Džordžova otkrića! Onda Džordž upoznaje bebu lenjivca, koja se kreće sporije od svega i svakoga koga je Džordž ikada video. Kakvo zadivljujuće stvorenje! Lenjivci ne idu majmunskom brzinom, pa Džordž mora da ide lenjivačkom brzinom - a to je možda pravi način da Džordž vrati bebu do njene mame, i završi svoju potragu za orhidejom.

programme.title: Pets klub
programme.desc: Krišom od svojih roditelja, Ema čuva dve angorske koze: mamu i njeno jare. Ali jednoga jutra mama nestaje. U panici, članovi Pets kluba moraju da nauče kako da hrane jare! Srećom, naši junaci ubrzo otkrivaju da je drug Eminog brata Žideon, tinejdžer prekriven aknama, ukrao kozu jer je kozje mleko vrlo delotvorno protiv akni! Ali majka je uspela da pobegne iz Žideonove kuće da bi našla svoje jare, koje je takođe nestalo! Pada noć, a naši drugari kreću u potragu za dve koze u nezgodnoj situaciji.

programme.title: Pets klub
programme.desc: Pets klub ima zadatak da pronađe retkog i egzotičnog ljubimca: ženku kameleona. Ali nije lako doći do životinje koja ima naviku da se stapa sa okruženjem. Stvar postaje još hitnija kad naši junaci saznaju da će kameleon dobiti bebe! Za to vreme, Tim je vrlo zauzet jer Marlu mora da se vakciniše. Hoće li Pets klub uspeti da pronađe kameleona i vakciniše Marlua.

programme.title: Pets klub
programme.desc: Evropska mačka je nestala - jednostavan zadatak za Pets klub... Osim za Ninu, koja je alergična na mačju dlaku! Nije lako u ovim uslovima pronaći zalutalu macu Šaljivdžiju... Drugi poziv usložnjava stvar, jer je nestala još jedna mačka, samo par kuća dalje... Maca Grejalica, koja takođe voli da luta. Kakva zagonetka! Da li je to talas otmica? Deci je teško da reše ovu zagonetku, sve dok ih Ninina alergija ne izbavi iz ove situacije.

programme.title: Pets klub
programme.desc: U poslednje vreme, Dijanina turska van mačka se čudno ponaša. Dijana veruje da ona vidi... Duhove! Znajući da neke kullture veruju da mačka ima ""šesto čulo"" za takve stvari, Nina postaje veoma zainteresovana za tu pretpostavku, ali Oskar je uveren da postoji razumno objašnjenje. Hoće li Nina uspeti da komunicira sa duhovima? Osim ako napuštena susedna kuća ne otkrije sve svoje tajne.

programme.title: Garfild
programme.desc: Garfild je lenji, sebični, gojazni narandžasti mačak čiji omiljeni hobiji su: izležavanje, spavanje, gledanje televizije, proždiranje pice i zabavljanje... Ali on ima veliko srce i, mada prvo obično pokaže svoju sebičnu stranu, zahvaljujući svojoj genijalnosti, uspeva da spasi stvar, pa čak i da izbavi Odija iz nevolje.

programme.title: Garfild
programme.desc: Vlasnik knjižare Rupert pozvao je Džona Arbakla da daje autograme, ali... Ne pojavljuje se nijedan čitalac i niko nije došao da se divi posebnom izdanju stripa o Ultramoćnom Tipu u izlogu knjižare. Utučeni Rupert moraće da zatvori knjižaru. Na njegovu sreću, Garfild se priključuje sa svojom idejom: u knjižari prosto mora da se pojavi superheroj. Možda onaj najherojskiji među njima? Osvetnik sa plaštom dolazi da spasi Ruperta... i rešava zagonetku.

programme.title: Pustolovine sa Braćom Kret
programme.desc: Tortuga je parkirana na Velikom Severu i, zbog nekih čudnih zvukova, Koki misli da je vreme za dijagnostički pregled. Prilazeći teritoriji čopora Malog Drekavca, braća odlučuju da potraže vučji čopor. Neočekivano, gavran se pridružuje Martinu i Krisu u pustolovini i braća uskoro saznaju nešto više o neverovatnoj inteligenciji i genijalnosti gavranova.

programme.title: Pustolovine sa Braćom Kret
programme.desc: Kada završe nasukana i izgubljena daleko od Tortuge, braća Kret moraju da krenu na dugo putovanje kući. Ekipa nalazi nadahnuće u vidu nekoliko sova koje usput sreće. Pošto sove žive na svim kontinentima osim Antarktika, Aviva misli da je to sigurno nekakav znak. Ima dovoljno zaliha i snage da napravi moćno odelo jedne životinje, i to samo jedno. Na kraju, od sovine moći zavisi da li će uspeti da se vrate kući.

programme.title: Pustolovine sa Braćom Kret
programme.desc: Kris i Martin odlaze da istraže planinske biozone Kozje planine i sreću Pejzli Kaldrmu. Pejzli im otkriva svoj užasni plan razvoja po imenu ""Uspon asfalta"". Braća su zgrožena. Trčeći pred rudu, Kris je izaziva na trku do vrha Kozje planine. Ko prvi stigne do vrha, odlučuje o budućnosti planinskog ekosistema. Postoji li stvorenje na ovim strmim padinama i vrtoglavim visinama koje može da pomogne Krisu da pobedi? Na scenu stupa planinska koza.

programme.title: Mali Šef: Nazad u kolevku
programme.desc: Nagon događaja u filmu Mali Šef 2, odraslom poslovnom čoveku Teodoru Templtonu smeštena je pronevera u kompaniji i primoran je da se vrati svom starom ja, Malom Šefu, i živi sa svojim bratom Timom. Ali da bi to izveo, mora da navede Timovu porodicu da mu dopusti da ostane, i ubedi Bebiko da mu vrati njegov stari posao... Koji trenutno obavlja njegova nećaka, beba Tina.

programme.title: Mali Šef: Nazad u kolevku
programme.desc: Nagon događaja u filmu Mali Šef 2, odraslom poslovnom čoveku Teodoru Templtonu smeštena je pronevera u kompaniji i primoran je da se vrati svom starom ja, Malom Šefu, i živi sa svojim bratom Timom. Ali da bi to izveo, mora da navede Timovu porodicu da mu dopusti da ostane, i ubedi Bebiko da mu vrati njegov stari posao... Koji trenutno obavlja njegova nećaka, beba Tina.

programme.title: Garfild
programme.desc: Džon je priredio prijatan izlet kraj obale jezera, ali negde na ovom ostrvu je i tajna baza u kojoj sumanuti naučnik doktor Pazl održava Treću godišnju konvenciju zlih genijalaca, na kojoj predstavlja retro-zamenski laserski pištolj, oružje kojim ličnosti mogu da se zamene. Da bi prikazao svoj izum, doktor Pazl razgleda obalu i, evo ih! Neodoljivi Nermal postaje ljutiti Bruno... Bruno postaje Garfild... Garfild postaje Nermal... Kada ih žaba čija je ličnost zamenjena sa ličnošću tajnog agenta uvede u bazu... Garfild kao Nermal će ih sve spasiti.

programme.title: Garfild
programme.desc: Meteorit regresivnih moći pao je u blizini! One koje obasja, pretvara u njihov praistorijski oblik. Džon, Garfild i Odi su u Vitovoj piceriji, kada muva koja je sletela na meteorit postaje čudovište od dva metra. Brzo! Vito zove policiju, ali pre nego što poručnik Stoun stigne, meteorit pada na Odijevu šapu. Muva je ponovo smanjena na normalnu veličinu, dok se Odi pretvara u ogromnu čudovišnu kucu! Kada čuje televizijsko obraćanje poručnika Stouna, šinter Al kreće u poteru za tim psom. Džon i Garfild moraju da spasu džina Odija.

programme.title: Barbi u priči o poniju
programme.desc: Barbi i njene mlađe sestre idu u avanturu u Švajcarsku, u živopisne Alpe, gde već sa radošću čekaju da celo leto provedu na akademiji jahanja koja im nudi neverovatnu razonodu! Barbi uzbuđeno traži sebi novog konja, kojeg bi i Malibuba želila da odnese kući. Stejsi bezuslovno želi da dokaže kako je neverovatno dobar džokej. Čelzi po svaku cenu želi da skoči u sedlo, a Skiper... ona više voli da piše o ovim veličanstvenim avanturama, nego da ih doživljava na svojoj koži. Mada odmor za sestre krene malo truckavo, kada Barbi nailazi na tajanstveni divlji konj u šumi, njihov školski raspust iznenada postaje magičnim.

programme.title: Pets klub
programme.desc: Tog dana nestao je Alisin mužjak feretke, Perce. Naši mladi istraživači veruju da se krije u kućici na drvetu ili u bašti, jer feretke vole da se igraju žmurke. Ali uprkos trudu, ne mogu da ga nađu! Pets klub je prvi put na ivici da odustane, ali tada otkriva da se feretka jako dobro slagala sa mačkom komšija koje su se odselile. Žilu potvrđuje: mačke i feretke mogu da postanu vrlo bliski drugari! Prema tome, da bi našli feretku, drugari iz Pets kluba najpre moraju da nađu njenog najboljeg drugara..

programme.title: Anderdog - Kuconja
programme.desc: Gradonačelnica otkriva statue branilaca, ali sve one izgledaju smešno, osim Robo-kucine. Kuconja je ljubomoran. Kao i Lošika, koja će upotrebiti statue da bi stvorila džumbus po gradu i podigla sopstvenu ogromnu statuu.

programme.title: Anderdog - Kuconja
programme.desc: Branioci u štabu branilaca mole Poli za još moći i uređaja, ali oglašava se alarm: banka je opljačkana, i to bez znakova provale! Kad branioci odu u grad, otkrivaju da je Mačkoslav iz lampe oslobodio letargičnog duha koji može da mu ispuni svaku želju. Dok su branioci zadivljeni duhom i žele da traže da im ispunjava želje, Čaro-kuca tvrdi da mrzi duhove jer su oni uljezi.

programme.title: Ulica zagonetki
programme.desc: Tokom neobičnog nestanka struje u okrugu Leksington u Londonu, sva svetla i elektronski uređaji se isključuju. Klever istražuje mesto pljačke zlatare, koja je podjednako čudna.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! i veverice
programme.desc: Sajmon je izumeo robota sa osećanjima i sposobnošću da uči ali sve je krenulo naopako kada je dobio pristup internetu.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! i veverice
programme.desc: Nakon brige o bolesnoj Britani, Elenor i Džanet se pitaju da li bi Britani brinula o njima da su one bolesne.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! i veverice
programme.desc: Veverice pokušavaju da spreče Dejva da ode na internet, nakon što njegov nastup dobije negativne komentare.

programme.title: Garfild
programme.desc: Bliznakinje Minerva i Drusila došle su kod Džona da bi videle Garfilda. Ali Garfild bi radije pobegao nego postao igračka za previše živahnu decu. Džon, u želji da ih zabavi, odlučuje da im ispriča priču o Peni Heni, zabrinutoj kokoški koja misli da će joj nebo pasti na glavu. Ali njih ne zanima priča, one žele Garfilda. Džon odlučuje da malo začini priču, sa Garfildom kao šaljivdžijom koji želi da se zabavi sa Peni Heni i ostatkom gradića. Ali sve je to zabavno dok Peni Heni i ostatak ekipe ne ispričaju to pogrešnoj osobi: lisici Frediju.

programme.title: Garfild
programme.desc: Kišni dan nad kućom Džona Arbakla. Savršen za gledanje gusarskih filmova. Garfildova mašta uskoro počinje da radi i kuća postaje gusarski brod, koji se probija kroz oluju. Sa Skvikom kao brodarcem, i Odijem kao malim od palube ""Odijem Nosom"", kapetan Garfild je u potrazi za blagom. Oni pojma nemaju da neki veoma nezgodni psi, Rotvajler, Herkul i Vilfred traže skrovište od kiše, kao i nešto za jelo. A izgleda da je Garfildov brod odlično mesto za to. Ali kada kapetan Garfild i njegova posada nabasaju na odmetnute gusare, moraju da ih pobede da bi sačuvali svoje blago.

programme.title: Kruds - Porodično Stablo
programme.desc: Kada roditelji vide da je njihov dragoceni poljski klozet uništen, organizuju ""suđenje"" da bi našli krivca. Da bi dokazali svoju nevinost, svi klinci daju svoje objašnjenje za uništenje poljskog klozeta.

programme.title: Kruds - Porodično Stablo
programme.desc: Nakon velike svađe Krudsa i Betermanovih, roditelji odlučuju da razdvoje porodice. Ne želeći da se razdvoje, klinci pokušavaju da ubede roditelje da se pomire pre nego što se Krudsi zauvek odsele sa farme.

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: Dve sestre. Dve eksplozivne ličnosti. Pod jednim krovom. "Sestre" je komedija o svakodnevnom životu dve sestre, od kojih jedna ima 7, a druga 13 godina. Marin je i dalje dete, dok njena starija sestra Vendi ulazi u tinejdžerske godine. Obe su temperamentne, veoma različite ličnosti i obožavaju se! Marin je naivna, simpatična, veoma hiperaktivna i veoma napadna. Ona uvek smišlja lude ideje da bi privukla pažnju svoje sestre, dok Vendi više teži životu odrasle osobe. Ova komedija karaktera govori o bratstvu/sestrinstvu.

programme.desc: Dobrodošli u carstvo tatinih ćerki u kom žive polusestre Panda, Ondin, Roksana i beba Bela. Zavirite u nepredvidivu i razdraganu svakodnevnicu ove nekonvencionalne porodice. Ovaj porodični sitkom prosto morate da pogledate.

programme.desc: Dobrodošli u carstvo tatinih ćerki u kom žive polusestre Panda, Ondin, Roksana i beba Bela. Zavirite u nepredvidivu i razdraganu svakodnevnicu ove nekonvencionalne porodice. Ovaj porodični sitkom prosto morate da pogledate.

programme.title: Nekada davno... Planeta Zemlja
programme.desc: Čuvari planete lično će se uveriti u uticaj koji seča i uništavanje šuma imaju na životinje i tradicionalne zajednice koje zavise od svog okruženja. Šta će se dogoditi ovim drevnim narodima ukoliko uništimo šume.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! i veverice
programme.desc: Alvin slaže Teodora za lažan praznik da ne bi radio kućne poslove pa ga Dejv natera da učini taj praznik stvarnim.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! i veverice
programme.desc: Sajmon je napravio dron koji napada grad i ne samo da dostavlja pice već može i da uči.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! i veverice
programme.desc: Kad Alvin sazna da je Dejv bio rok zvezda, zabrine se da je Dejv postao dosadan zbog njih trojice.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! i veverice
programme.desc: Kad otmu Teodorovog medu Tedija, momci sarađuju s policajcom Dangusom da ga vrate.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! i veverice
programme.desc: Alvin krade novine da bi ih prodavao u školi pa Dejv optuži raznosača novina i odbija da mu plati.

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: Marina ne može da nauči tablicu množenja i smeta svojoj sestri koja piše pesmu za Maksansa. Da bi dobila malo mira i tišine, Vendi odlučuje da joj pomogne, ali u Marininoj glavi sve se meša i ona ne može da nauči tablicu množenja napamet. Kad isproba nekoliko metoda, Vendi odlučuje da pozove Super Piju-Pijua. Može li Marinin junak da joj pomogne da nauči tablicu množenja?

programme.title: Džeronimo Stilton
programme.desc: Džeronimo je gospodin miš koji, pored toga što voli svoj posao i svoju porodicu, obožava da skuplja korice starog sira iz osamnaestog veka. Mrzi da putuje jer mu svako putovanje, bilo brodom, kolima ili avionom, izaziva mučninu... Ali ga, bez obzira na to, porodica uvlači u najneverovatnije pustolovine svuda po svetu.

programme.title: Džeronimo Stilton
programme.desc: Ime mu je Stilton, Džeronimo Stilton. Pisac u zemlji glodara, koji piše najbolje priče! Očaravajući, neverovatan glavni urednik koji je i veliki avantrurista! U tri reči: humor, avantura i ...humor! Doživljaji malog, pametnog miša, Džeronima Stiltona su puni uzbuđenja, akcije i sve to začinjeno sa malo humora. Naravno, to ne znači da se naši junaci ne upetljavaju u razne opasne situacije iz kojih se ipak uvek uspešno izvlače i izlaze kao pobednici. Džeronimovi drugari i članovi porodice pomažu mu da savlada prepreke i da uspešno istražuje i zajedno su za sve sposobni. Ponekad, ipak dolazi do nesuglasica i to prouzrokuje smešne situacije, ali se na kraju svi pomire, jer se bezuslovno.

programme.title: Džeronimo Stilton

programme.desc: Ime mu je Stilton, Džeronimo Stilton. Pisac u zemlji glodara, koji piše najbolje priče! Očaravajući, neverovatan glavni urednik koji je i veliki avantrurista! U tri reči: humor, avantura i ...humor! Doživljaji malog, pametnog miša, Džeronima Stiltona su puni uzbuđenja, akcije i sve to začinjeno sa malo humora. Naravno, to ne znači da se naši junaci ne upetljavaju u razne opasne situacije iz kojih se ipak uvek uspešno izvlače i izlaze kao pobednici. Džeronimovi drugari i članovi porodice pomažu mu da savlada prepreke i da uspešno istražuje i zajedno su za sve sposobni. Ponekad, ipak dolazi do nesuglasica i to prouzrokuje smešne situacije, ali se na kraju svi pomire, jer se bezuslovno.

programme.title: Zoro
programme.desc: Naša nova serija predstavlja tinejdžera Don Dijega, koji se suočava sa najvećim životnim izazovom boreći se za pravdu protiv brojnih bezobzirnih tirana! Tako se rađa najpoznatiji maskirani heroj. Zoro jednostavno ismeva svoje protivnike učeći ih lekciji i potpisuje svoja dela zaštitnim znakom "Z".
